questions.standard_level: Algebra I. Common Core groups high-school standards by category, not by course; this bank places this one in Algebra I, following the Common Core traditional pathway (Appendix A) except where engine/hs_courses.py says otherwise.
questions.prompt: g(x) = (x - 4)² + 1. Describe how to get the graph of g from the graph of y = x².

g(x) = (x - 4)² + 1.

questions.correct_answer: Shift it 4 units right and 1 unit up.
questions.grading_note: Any equivalent description of both shifts.

questions.prompt: f(x) = x². Compare g(x) = 3f(x) and h(x) = f(3x). Which is a vertical stretch and which is a horizontal compression? Are g and h the same function?
questions.prompt_markup:
f(x) = x². Compare g(x) = 3f(x) and h(x) = f(3x).
Which is a vertical stretch and which is a horizontal compression? Are g and h the same function?
questions.correct_answer: g(x) = 3x² is a vertical stretch by 3; h(x) = 9x² is a horizontal compression by a factor of {1/3}. They are not the same.
questions.grading_note: Form required: both descriptions and the comparison. (3x)² = 9x².
